categories.direct_to_device_satellite_constellation: A named direct-to-device satellite system or deployment plan.
categories.distributed_internet_exchange: A named distributed traffic-exchange service, distinct from each host building or member network.
categories.interconnection_corridor: A connectivity collaboration/corridor, distinct from one new physical cable.
categories.leo_satellite_constellation: A named low-Earth-orbit communications system, not a row per spacecraft.
categories.network_interconnect_presence: A provider-listed private interconnect directory entry, which can group multiple host facilities.
categories.optical_ground_station: A specifically described optical satellite ground station or trial facility.
categories.optical_quantum_network_testbed: A named optical/quantum network testbed that can include simulated infrastructure.
categories.orbital_compute_constellation: A named planned orbital computing system; plans do not establish launched compute sites.
categories.quantum_optical_ground_station: An optical ground station commissioned for quantum-network experimentation.
categories.satellite_gateway_authorization: A regulator-listed gateway licence; distinct from observed operation, ownership or unique campuses.
categories.satellite_network_authorization: A regulator-listed network licence; not a constellation inventory or ground-site count.
categories.space_situational_awareness_system: A named space-traffic sensing/coordination system; orbital sensors are not ground stations.
categories.submarine_cable_branch: A specifically announced branch of a named cable system.
categories.submarine_cable_system: A named submarine fiber system, not a surveyed path, landing building or lit-capacity measurement.
categories.subsea_connectivity_program: A named programme grouping cable systems; not an additional cable asset.
categories.terrestrial_fiber_backbone_network: An operator's backbone network declaration with bounded aggregate claims.
categories.terrestrial_fiber_link: A named terrestrial fiber system; cities and design capacity are not a surveyed alignment.
